name: reflectai-gemini-reflection-journal
description: An AI-powered reflection journal built with Google AI Studio, Gemini, and Cloud Run.

name: raizo-edtech
description: RAIZO is an AI-powered EdTech platform that teaches, assesses, verifies, and certifies practical data analytics skills. It combines Socratic AI tutoring, hands-on learning, assessments, real-world projects, skill evidence, career intelligence, and verified credentials to help learners turn knowledge into demonstrable job-ready capability.

name: Seasonal-Agriculture-Performance-Analysis
description: It is a data analytics project that examines agricultural performance across Kharif, Rabi, and Zaid seasons. Using Python, Pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib, and Seaborn, the project analyzes crop yield, production, profitability, environmental conditions, water usage, irrigation, and seasonal patterns to generate data-driven agricultural insights.

name: AI-Chef-Application
description: AI-powered Chef app built with Gemini, Streamlit, and Google Cloud. Generates personalized recipes based on cuisine, dietary preferences, allergies, ingredients, and wine preferences, with nutrition insights and Cloud Run deployment.

name: CymbalMart-AI-Party-Planner-Shopping-Assistant.
description: AI-powered party planning and shopping assistant with smart budgeting, guest management, personalized invitations, RSVP tracking, Google Maps navigation, Google Calendar integration, voice control, and Gemini-powered recommendations.

name: Projects
description: A collection of real-world data analytics projects focused on data cleaning, KPI analysis, visualization, dashboards, and actionable business insights.
